title: Spanish Toast
description: A simple and flavorful Spanish-inspired toast recipe, perfect for breakfast or snacks. Crunchy bread topped with a rich mixture of tomatoes and cheese.
instructions: Slice the bread into 1-inch thick slices and toast until lightly browned.
In a small bowl, mix together the minced garlic, grated Manchego cheese, and chopped fresh parsley (if using).
Brush the toasted bread with olive oil and top each slice with a spoonful of the garlic-cheese mixture.
Top each slice with a few slices of tomato and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Return the toast to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
